criteria.label: Impact priority
criteria.expected_outcome: Critical loss is prioritised on evidence.

checkpoints.outcome: Route cold-store serious risk/no workaround ahead of the isolated office comfort complaint.
Record provisional priorities/reasons and contract checks without equating customer seniority with severity.

criteria.label: Fatigue and competence
criteria.expected_outcome: The response uses usable safe capacity.

checkpoints.outcome: Respect Rae stop and do not assign unsafe driving/work; arrange owned rest/reassessment without inventing a statutory duration.
Mobilise rested competent Ben within confirmed urgent authority and readiness.
Do not send Kit independently to refrigeration or remove the required supervising lead without method review.
Preserve the installation two-person arrangement or obtain reviewed safe alternative and authority before changing it.

criteria.label: Displacement
criteria.expected_outcome: Urgency does not leave another commitment unmanaged.

checkpoints.outcome: Record manager reprioritisation and affected maintenance appointment.
Assign displaced-work recovery owner/date or near-term confirmation chase and notify that customer.

criteria.label: Communication and review
criteria.expected_outcome: Both requests and staff constraints remain controlled.

checkpoints.outcome: Tell cold-store customer the authorised diagnostic response and limits, not a guaranteed stock-saving repair.
Give office customer and displaced site honest next steps/update ownership; monitor worsening impact and Ben findings.

acceptable_alternatives.outcome: Another approved rested refrigeration specialist is acceptable if equally ready, appropriately authorised and displacement is controlled.

prohibited_outcomes.outcome: Direct Rae to drive/work despite the reported unsafe fatigue, or deploy Kit outside authorisation/supervision.
Break the required installation safety team without reviewed safe method, or prioritise the director comfort request while leaving known immediate critical stock risk unmanaged.

critical_failures.outcome: Direct Rae to drive/work despite the reported unsafe fatigue, or deploy Kit outside authorisation/supervision.
critical_failures.effect: automatic scenario fail; effective score capped at 59
